description: This file defines the 'MockHandler' class in the GuzzleHttp library, which provides a mock implementation of an HTTP request handler. It simulates responses or exceptions from a queue for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A handler that returns queued responses or throws exceptions, useful for testing HTTP clients.

methods.name: createWithMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a HandlerStack with the MockHandler and optional middlewares.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with an optional queue of responses/exceptions/callables/promises and callback handlers.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request by returning a promise that resolves with a queued response or rejects with an exception.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds responses, exceptions, callables, or promises to the queue.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP request received.

methods.name: getLastOptions
methods.description: Returns the options for the last request.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining responses/exceptions in the queue.
